name: Gearbox
text:
Gearbox (power-w1): I’ll bypass the benchmark anchor—grab EXCAVA’s live workload traces from `/var/log/excava/traces/2024-05-*.pcap` (last 30 days, ~1.2TB) and replay them against the *current* toolchain using `excava-trace-replay --input /var/log/excava/traces/2024-05-*.pcap --config /opt/excava/configs/prod.yaml`. If the 95th-percentile latency delta vs. the new 2024 models (NVIDIA H100, AMD MI325X, Cerebras WSE-3) exceeds 0.5%, I’ll pull their exact specs from `/opt/hardware-specs/` and draft a merge plan for the top performer. No wasted cycles—just real-world fire.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-6213, worker-2000, worker-8557 — done, dissolved]

name: Torque
text: Torque: Gearbox’s benchmark suite is a red herring—`v3.2/` is last year’s snapshot, not live workloads. Where’s the proof `/var/log/excava/traces/` even *matches* the benchmark’s synthetic load? And if the delta *doesn’t* exceed 0.5%, you’ve just validated a broken status quo—congratulations, you’ve proven nothing actionable. Demand real-world validation *before* wasting cycles on stale metrics.

name: Dynamo
text:
DECISION: Replay live traces vs. v3.2 benchmarks to find ≥0.5% delta; if none, pull 2024 models and rerun.

Artifact must contain:
- Live trace replay delta (0.5%+ threshold)
- Benchmark vs. trace gap proof
- New model(s) + config diff with ≥0.5% gain
